record.question: What will be the term of the office of Presiding Officer under the Mizoram (Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement) Ordinance, 2015?
options: He shall hold office for the term of two years from the date on which he enters upon his office or until he attains the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier
He shall hold office for the term of three years from the date on which he enters upon his office or until he attains the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier
He shall hold office for the term of four years from the date on which he enters upon his office or until he attains the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier
He shall hold office for the term of five years from the date on which he enters upon his office or until he attains the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier
